newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Genesis Health rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Genesis Health rated buy.

text.p: ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Monday it began coverage of Genesis Health Ventures Inc with a buy rating and a $40 a share price target.
-- Genesis Health shares traded up 1-1/4 at 32-3/8.
-- Genesis Health provides health care and support services for the elderly.
-- "We believe (Genesis Health) can grow EPS without additional facility acquisitions by 23 percent and 24 percent during fiscal years 1997 and 1998, respectively," ABN AMRO said in a report.
-- It said the $40 price target is based on 19.3 times the 1998 calendar earnings estimate of $2.07 a share. Its fiscal 1997 estimate is $1.62 a share and fiscal 1998 estimate is $2.00 a share.
